objective: T-20260929-33: test whether published crypto trend/momentum rules (Alpaca spot, long-only) can reach the 2026-09-28 relaxed keep bar (K1: judged Sharpe within 80% of S3's own anchor/stress Sharpe, i.e. >=1.19 anchor / >=0.65 stress, net-20bp CAGR positive both windows; K2: >=0.05 Sharpe edge combined with S3) either standalone (K1) or as a diversifier added to S3 (K2), using the batch screening lane. Registry rows dir:crypto_trend_btc and dir:crypto_xs_momentum are reopened under the new keep-bar/scope ruling (see existing_solution_comparison), not because of new data.
target_regime_and_horizon: Frozen screen_lane windows unchanged (scripts/screen_lane.py WINDOWS): select 2023-09-18..2025-12-31, anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17, holdout 2026-01-02..2026-09-17 (contaminated, reference only), stress 2016-05-02..2023-09-15. Crypto session prices are sampled at the US equity session (09:30/16:00 ET) on every day the SPY SIP daily panel has a bar, so the crypto series inherits the same trading-day calendar as the rest of the panel (weekends/holidays excluded even though crypto itself trades 24/7 -- a deliberate scope-of-rule choice, not a data gap, recorded here before any result). BTC/ETH history via Coinbase goes back to 2016-05 inside the stress window; altcoins (LINK, UNI, AAVE, DOGE, AVAX, DOT, BCH) only have Binance USDT history from their own listing dates (2019-2020 for most), so their stress-window Sharpe is computed on a shorter sample -- flagged 'stress sample short' per candidate in report.md, not silently included as if full-length.
existing_solution_comparison: `oc research directions check crypto trend` and `check bitcoin` (run before any new work) both return dir:crypto_trend_btc status=evidence_too_weak, verdict='headline numbers are below the bar even at face value' (old bar: >=50%/yr and DD<=35%, or Sharpe>=2 and >=30%/yr). `grep -ril crypto reports/research/control reports/research/iterations reports/research/ledger` finds no prior local backtest of this mechanism -- the only artifact is the intel note cited below; this is genuinely the first local test. What changed since 2026-09-23: (1) the owner relaxed the keep bar on 2026-09-28 to K1 (judged Sharpe >=80% of S3's own 1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress, i.e. >=1.19 / >=0.65) and K2 (diversifier edge >=0.05 both windows) -- the paper's own reported BTC-only Sharpe 1.56 (Zarattini/Pagani/Barbon 2025, SSRN 5209907, cited in reports/research/intel/I-20260923-02-hf-crypto-model-verification.md section 6a: net CAGR 30%, Sharpe 1.56, max DD -19% vs BTC buy-and-hold DD 'exceeding 80%'; Top-20 monthly rotation net CAGR 18%, DD -11%, alpha ~11% vs BTC) is already above the new K1 anchor bar at face value, which the old evaluation never tested because it used the old, higher bar; (2) the owner widened research scope on 2026-09-29 to everything Alpaca Paper can trade, including crypto spot, removing the prior implicit ETF/equity-only framing. Neither change supplies new market data or a new claim about the strategy -- this is a new judgment standard applied to the same published numbers, stated here as required rather than silently reused. dir:crypto_xs_momentum (Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu 2022, weekly VW long-short quintiles, sample to 2018) is also reopened for a long-only cross-sectional variant only -- the original long-short design and stale sample remain disqualifying for a literal replication, so this round tests a different, long-only-compatible cross-sectional construction (absolute-momentum-filtered top-3 rotation among Alpaca-tradable coins), not the LTW paper's own long-short rule.
remaining_evidence_gap: SSRN 5209907's own PDF returns 403/Cloudflare on direct fetch (confirmed again this round); the 30%/1.56/-19% and 18%/-11% numbers are read from the intel report's cross-check of three secondary pages (author's own Concretum Group site, Concretum Substack, and Andrea Barbon's personal academic page), which agreed with each other but are all author-affiliated, not independent. This round adds one more independent check: a WebSearch summary of the same SSRN abstract page (not opened directly) reporting an alternate framing ("On a rotational portfolio of the 20 most liquid coins from January 2015 to March 2025 ... CAGR 30%, Sharpe 1.58") that does not cleanly separate the BTC-only and Top-20-rotation figures the way the intel report's cross-checked pages do -- flagged as a possible AI-search-summary conflation, not trusted over the three-way author-page cross-check. The paper's exact Donchian lookback windows (it says 'nine different lookback periods' per the intel note's paraphrase, but no primary source we could open lists the specific day counts) are NOT recovered from any source opened this round; the BTC_DONCHIAN_ENSEMBLE candidate below uses a self-constructed geometric window ladder (10/20/30/45/65/95/140/200/290 calendar days, converted to trading-day-equivalent per this round's day-count convention) as a deliberate, clearly-labeled approximation of the published ensemble mechanism, not a literal replication of unknown parameters.
negative_experiments_checked: dir:crypto_trend_btc (evidence_too_weak under the old bar, reopened here under the new bar/scope -- reason above) and dir:crypto_xs_momentum (evidence_too_weak, long-short design + stale sample, reopened here only for a long-only variant) are the only matching rows in reports/research/harvest/directions.jsonl. No local iteration/control/ledger file matches 'crypto' before this round (grep above). Adjacent negative evidence considered: Bitwise BTOP (10/20-day BTC/ETH EMA trend rotation on CME futures vs T-bills, launched 2023-09-29, liquidated 2026-05-29 per the issuer's own site) is a live, roughly-2.7-year record of a similar mechanism (EMA trend, not Donchian) on a different venue (CME futures, not spot) that did not survive as a product despite a reported since-inception NAV return of +30.70% (cumulative or annualized not disclosed) -- cited as a caution about live survivability of a similar mechanism, not a direct test of this rule, and not itself grounds to skip testing (different signal, different venue, and issuer discontinuation is not evidence the strategy lost money).
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Unchanged screen_lane contract: 10bp/20bp per side, signal at bar close, fill at next bar open, weights_fn reads close.loc[:asof] only. Additional preregistered crypto-fee check (brief-mandated, applies only to candidates that clear K1 or K2 at 10bp): re-run the same screen_lane evaluation functions with COST_BPS_PRIMARY/COST_BPS_STRESS overridden to 30.0 (Alpaca lowest-tier taker 25bp -- confirmed 2026-09-29 from docs.alpaca.markets/docs/crypto-fees, tiered 0.25% taker / 0.15% maker at $0-100k 30-day volume down to 0.10%/0.00% at $100M+ -- plus an assumed ~5bp spread) for anchor and stress windows only; a candidate that met K1/K2 at 10bp but not at 30bp is reported as 'fee-fails' rather than kept. Equity-side legs of any candidate (SHY remainder, SPY/BTC dual-momentum's non-crypto leg if any) keep the standard 10/20bp, not 30bp, in that same check -- only the crypto legs' cost is raised, since Alpaca's equity/ETF commission structure is unrelated to its separately-tiered crypto fee schedule.
stop_condition: K1: judged (single value, freq='D') or median-offset (freq='M'/'W') net-10bp anchor Sharpe >=1.19 and stress Sharpe >=0.65 (or, for candidates with <2yr of stress-window data, computed on the available stress-window subsample and labeled 'stress sample short'; candidates with <2yr are labeled 'stress period pending' and judged on select+anchor only), and net-20bp CAGR positive in both windows, for at least one non-placebo candidate. K2: diversifier judged_edge (S3+candidate inverse-63d-vol blend vs vol-matched S3+SHY control) >=0.05 in both anchor and stress windows. watch_recent: anchor Sharpe >=1.19 but stress (or the available stress subsample) unmet. Any candidate that clears K1 or K2 at 10bp must also still clear the same tier at the 30bp crypto-fee check above, else it is downgraded to 'fee-fails' in report.md and NOT written to kept.jsonl. Falsification: any keeper must beat its own BTC_RAND_PLACEBO on judged anchor Sharpe; if not, demote to 'not kept (placebo replication)', same convention as prior batches (e.g. h20260929_01_letf_flow_reversal).

sources.claim: Sharpe ratio above 1.5, Annualized alpha of 10.8% relative to Bitcoin
sources.market_and_period: BTC and top liquid crypto by market cap, 2015 onward (paper's own survivorship-bias-free universe description).
sources.applicability: Primary numeric basis for BTC_DONCHIAN_ENSEMBLE and the multi-coin rotation candidate in this iteration; exact Donchian lookback windows are not recoverable from any source opened, so this iteration's implementation is a labeled approximation, not a literal replication. The more precise BTC-only figures (CAGR 30%, Sharpe 1.56, max DD -19%) and Top-20 rotation figures (CAGR 18%, DD -11%) cited in existing_solution_comparison come from reports/research/intel/I-20260923-02-hf-crypto-model-verification.md's prior three-way cross-check of this same author's pages (this page, the author's Substack mirror, and Andrea Barbon's personal academic page), not from this specific snapshot alone -- this snapshot itself only literally states the Sharpe>1.5 / alpha 10.8% figures quoted above.
sources.limitations: SSRN full text (papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5209907) returns 403/Cloudflare on direct fetch, both this round and in the prior 2026-09-23 intel pass -- UNREAD. This page is issuer/author-affiliated (Concretum Group is the lead author's own research firm), not independently produced.
sources.independent_replication: None opened this round for the exact BTC single-leg mechanism/numbers. Quantpedia's own from-scratch Bitcoin trend-following review (quantpedia.com/revisiting-trend-following-and-mean-reversion-strategies-in-bitcoin, WebSearch summary only, not formally bound here) independently corroborates the qualitative direction -- simple BTC trend-following (their 'MAX' rule) 'remains alive and well' out-of-sample through Aug 2024, while mean-reversion decayed -- without reproducing this paper's specific Donchian-ensemble construction or numbers.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Preregister 12 mechanism candidates (BTC buy-and-hold, BTC 200d-equivalent SMA filter, BTC 1/3/6-month time-series momentum, BTC Donchian ensemble (D and vt40 versions), a multi-coin Donchian/momentum rotation among the 10-coin Alpaca universe, BTC+ETH dual momentum, cross-sectional top-3 momentum rotation (equal-weight and inverse-vol versions, D and vt40)) plus 1 deterministic BTC random-timing placebo, and run scripts/screen_batch.py under the frozen screen_lane contract with the crypto panel supplied via extend_panel (no changes to screen_lane.py/screen_batch.py).
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one non-placebo candidate clears K1 or K2 at 10bp AND still clears the same tier at the 30bp crypto-fee check AND beats BTC_RAND_PLACEBO on judged anchor Sharpe.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No candidate clears K1 or K2 at 10bp, or every apparent clearer fails at 30bp (fee-fails), or is matched/beaten by BTC_RAND_PLACEBO on judged anchor Sharpe.
